name: Temporal Anchor
displayText: Once each turn, when an enemy Unit would become Ready, you may pay 1 Energy. If you do, it remains Exhausted.

notes: Every permanent readies at the same moment, so you are asked once, at that moment, and name the one you want held down.
You pay out of the Energy you have during that opponent's turn. If you cannot afford it, you are not asked.
A Unit already held down by another effect is not offered, so you never pay for something that was going to stay Exhausted anyway.
